# Count the number of unique players per round for rounds 3 to 9
round_counts = df[df['round'].between(3, 9)]['round'].value_counts().sort_index()

# Check if all rounds from 3 to 9 have exactly 2 players
all_rounds_present = set(round_counts.index) == set(range(3, 10))
all_have_two = (round_counts == 2).all()

# The claim is true if both conditions hold
answer = all_rounds_present and all_have_two
